name: Rutersju
summary: Swedish trick-taking game where players bid exact tricks to win and the diamond seven is the unbeatable master card.
rules_text: Use a 36 card French pack. The ♦7 is the highest trump that wins any trick it is in. Deal three cards to each player. Going clockwise players bid 0 to 3 for the exact number of tricks they intend to take. Highest bidder becomes declarer; ties go to the last tied bidder. Declarer leads first trick alone against all others. Players must follow suit if able. Highest card of led suit wins unless ♦7 is played. Play three tricks. If declarer makes exactly the bid, declarer scores that many points. Otherwise each opponent scores one point per trick of difference between bid and tricks taken.
rating_reason: Rutersju Swedish exact bid, hidden hands, dealer bidding strategic.
